items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: He asked me if he could sit down in for a couple of numbers and naturally, I did not refuse him... He told me his name was Joe

ctx.x: After a few hours, Dolores, Lily and I were ready to go back, and left the others. There was no fix pathway to come down, so we took what we thought was the right direction, as we could not see the station from where we were. And we ran in quite a bit of trouble. Sometimes we would sink down in the snow knee deep and once Dolores went down to her waist, and if she had been a person that weighed 150 pounds or more, we would have had to scream for help. As it happened that she had a weight of about 125 pounds, I…

One night a party came to the Rosatsch and a fellow came up to me and said he was a pianist. He asked me if he could sit down in for a couple of numbers and naturally, I did not refuse him. He was an American, and a fine pianist. He told me his name was Joe, and he was in the party with Doris Duke, the five and ten per cent store heiress. I had never heard of him, but I did know who Doris Duke was, and I later found out that he was not only with her party, but with her... Lucky cat!
